GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE, NOT AN OFFICIAL NOTIFICATION)
Scheme Name: Kisan Samriddhi Sahayata Yojana (Sample)
Department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (sample)

Objective
The scheme gives direct yearly income support to small and marginal farmer families so that they can
buy seeds, fertiliser and other farm inputs on time. Support is paid directly into the bank account
of the beneficiary.

Benefits
- Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 each.
- Money is credited directly into the beneficiary's bank account.

Eligibility
1. The applicant must be a farmer who cultivates land.
2. Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh.
3. The family must own cultivable land of up to 2 hectares.
4. Applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra or West Bengal.

Exclusions
- Any family member who pays income tax.
- Any family member who is a serving or retired government employee.

Documents Required
- Aadhaar card
- Land ownership record
- Bank passbook with account number
- Passport size photograph

How to Apply
1. Visit your nearest Common Service Centre or the local agriculture office.
2. Fill the registration form with land and bank details.
3. Submit the listed documents for verification.
4. The local revenue officer verifies the details.
5. Instalments are credited to your bank account after approval.
